name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Trivial Concepts
proof: Either coordinate gives a prefix-$k$ shattered tree of depth one. The two constant concepts have Littlestone dimension one, and $\mathrm{PL}_k\leq\mathrm L$, so the value is exactly one.
references: Database-defined variant; the comparison $\mathrm{PL}_k\leq\mathrm L$ is Proposition \ref{prop:prefix-littlestone-order} in the survey
